dct_creator_sm: Morrison, Heather (University of Ottawa, University of Ottawa School of Information Studies).
dct_description_sm: Macro level data depicting the growth of open access. Updated quarterly (March 31, June 30, September 30, December 31 and usually an early December early year-end edition). This is a spreadsheet with multiple tab. The intention is to regularly update this dataverse with the latest version. Commentary and charts derived from the data are published on The Imaginary Journal of Poetic Economics.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
